kahan|n354.text: 1 UNITED STATES BANKRUPTCY COURT FOR THE DISTRICT OF MASSACHUSETTS (Eastern Division) __________________________________________ ) In re: ) ) Chapter 7 JASON M. KAHAN, ) ) Case No. 24-11592 (JEB) ) Debtor. ) __________________________________________) AMENDED NOTICE OF APPEAL Notice is hereby given that Appellants Samara CR Holdings, LLC (“ Samara”) and Jason M. Kahan (the “ Debtor” and together with Samara, the “ Appellants”) respectfully submit the following amendment to the Notice of Appeal filed on July 13, 2026, in order to include an additional order issued by the Bankruptcy Court dated July 17, 2026 (the “Sale Order”). The Sale Order is attached hereto as Exhibit A. The Sale Order is the memorialization of the oral decisions issued by the Bankruptcy Court on July 8, 2026 and July 10, 2026, which are the subject of this current appeal. The Appellants seek review of each of the Bankruptcy Court’s rulings in the Sale Order approving the sale of assets to PBTC Recovery Partners, LLC (“PBTC”), including without limitation, the determination that PBTC was granted 11 U.S.C. § 363(m) status as a good faith purchaser. In addition, the Appellants seek to add Donald R. Lassman as Chapter 7 Trustee to these proceedings as an additional Appellee since the Sale Order was issued in connection with the Chapter 7 Trustee’s Motion for: (I) Entry of an Order (A) Approving Procedures Governing Trustee’s Proposed Sale of Certain of the Debtor’s Assets Pursuant to Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code, Free and Clear of Liens, Claims, Encumbrances and Other Inter ests, (B) Case 24-11592 Doc 354 Filed 07/31/26 Entered 07/31/26 15:19:43 Desc Main Document Page 1 of 5 2 Approving Form and Manner of Notice of Sale, and (C) Granting Related Relief; and (II) Authority to Sell Certain of the Debtor’s Assets Pursuant to Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code, Free and Clear of Liens, Claims, Encumbrances and Other Interests. Except as amended herein, the original Notice of Appeal remains in effect. Dated: July 31, 2026 Respectfully submitted, SAMARA CR HOLDINGS, LLC and JASON M. KAHAN, By their counsel, /s/ Jesse I.
